name: @repo/scroll-progress
description: A reading-progress indicator with bar, ring, number and segmented variants.

useCases: Top-of-article reading progress bar for long-form content
Ring or number indicator for a documentation sidebar
Segmented progress for multi-step scrollytelling sections
compositionHints: Point container at the same scrollable box as scroll-image-reveal or svg-draw-on-scroll for a coordinated feel
Use the number or ring variant inside a sticky sidebar
